payload.claim: This docstring repeats the same misattribution as saffron/batch.py: it cites 'ADR 7's Money paragraph' for the writer_usd/reserve_usd rule, but ADR 7 has no such paragraph. The rule is stated in the 'Money' paragraph of section 3 of docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-23-stack-batch-design.md, not in ADR 7.
